packageRules.description: The pinned mCaptcha reference harness uses bincode 1 wire bytes; bincode 3 is an intentionally unbuildable compile_error crate and bincode 2 is a distinct encoding
mCaptcha 0.5 and 0.6 expose sha2 0.10 Sha256 in their dev::score API; sha2 0.11's distinct digest types cannot be supplied until upstream changes
